title: How are Venezuelans feeling, 48 hours after the US capture of Nicolas Maduro?
summary: In the biggest U.S. intervention in Latin America since the 1989 invasion of Panama, Special Forces swooped into Caracas on helicopters at the weekend to smash through Maduro's security cordon and nab him at the door of a safe room almost two days later, how are Venezuelans feeling? Details by James Andre, FRANCE 24 reporter in Cucuta, Colombia.
